currentPhase.description: Repository governance is bootstrapped while the standalone application continues bounded stabilization outside this repository.

authorizedWork: standalone functional and UX stabilization outside the repository
read-only source cartography when exact source becomes available
heldWork: localStorage to IndexedDB migration unless required for standalone stability
prohibitedWork: microservices before a demonstrated extraction need
synchronization of opaque global snapshots as the sole merge model
canonical identifiers derived from editable titles
direct UI coupling to storage or remote APIs
parallel AI implementation without exact baseline and machine-checkable scopes
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
presenting target architecture as current implementation

activeRisks.statement: The active standalone source is not yet present in the repository, so build reproducibility and architecture boundaries are not yet proven.
Branch protection and mandatory review rules are not yet independently verified through repository policy evidence.
Changed-file scope enforcement for AI work packages is specified but not yet implemented.

activeExceptions.rule: High-risk governance work normally requires an independent reviewer separate from the operational governor.
activeExceptions.reason: The repository currently has a single accountable owner and no additional reviewer identity. The initial governor bootstrap is documentation and validation tooling only, contains no application source, and is fully reversible.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: Remove before the first high or critical application, migration, security, synchronization, identity, entitlement, or release-provenance change is merged.
activeExceptions.rollback: Revert the standing-governor bootstrap pull request and retain the prior repository foundation.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: A standalone candidate is promoted and its exact source, artifact hash, human gate, tests, and known issues are available.

review.nextReviewTrigger: standalone candidate promotion, architecture-sensitive PR, serious regression, or release provenance change
